paragraphs: R. Yitzḥak ben Elazar, Sukkah (35b), Bava Batra (163a). Avin of Tzippori, before him. In the name of R. Ammi, the father of R. Avdumi of Tzippori. He said: R. Elazar ben Pedat studied while his sheet lay in the marketplace with a snake on it. He instructed R. Hoshaya bar Shammai, Jerusalem Talmud, Shabbat, end of chapter HaZorek, and chapter Mi SheHafakh, halakhah 3. In Ḥizkiyah's name, Ketubbot (27a, 109a), Avodah Zarah (48b). This entry says he sat at R. Ḥiyya bar Abba’s entrance; it also lists R. Ammi and R. Yitzḥak Nappaḥa [the parallel accounts in entries 2146 and 2147 instead put all three at his entrance; direction unresolved]. R. Yose ben Yose, in his name. R. Yitzḥak Nappaḥa (see above). He eulogized R. Pedat (see his entry). R. Shashna bar Shemuel bar Avdumi asked him and R. Mani (see his entry).
